### Non-Obvious Logic to Implement

1. **URL routing for sub-views:** `/people/view/{id}/call`, `/people/view/{id}/email`, `/people/view/{id}/note`, `/people/view/{id}/text` — the trailing path segment determines which action composer tab is active and shown on load. The URL changes when the user clicks different tabs.

2. **"Person N of M" pagination:** When navigating to a person from a filtered people list, the context of that list (its query/filter/sort) is preserved in session state so the ←/→ arrows and [←]/[→] keyboard shortcuts navigate through the same filtered list without going back to the list view.

3. **Activity feed filter tabs with counts:** Each tab shows a count of that event type in the person's activity log. The count badge is computed server-side on page load and included in the feed metadata. Clicking a tab is a client-side filter (no reload) that hides/shows event elements matching the type.

4. **Email open tracking badges:** The "2 opens" green badge on automated campaign emails requires server-side open tracking pixel callbacks that increment an `open_count` field on the email event record. The badge shows when `open_count > 0`.

5. **Source field inline editing:** The Source field has an edit-in-place pattern with a visible autocomplete dropdown showing predefined sources + "Recent:" section of recently used sources. The green ✓ / red ✗ inline save/cancel controls appear only while the field is in edit mode. On ✓ click, saves via PATCH API call and closes the edit mode. On ✗ click, reverts.

6. **Automation pause/resume:** The ‖ (pause) button on a running automation sends a PATCH request to pause the automation plan for this specific contact. The automation row should switch to show a ▶ (play/resume) button and "Paused" status.

7. **Text warming up state:** When `account.texting_status = 'warming_up'` (or equivalent), the Text tab shows the onboarding banner instead of an SMS composer. The "Try out texting" CTA sends a test message to demonstrate the UI flow even during warm-up.

8. **Overdue task styling:** Tasks with `due_at < now()` render their due date in orange/amber color to visually signal they are overdue, without any other structural change to the task item.

9. **AgentFire FUB Widget:** This is an embedded third-party widget using FUB's widget extension API — a sandboxed iframe or JSON-data-driven component injected by the AgentFire integration. The section header appears in the sidebar like native sections but content is third-party controlled.

10. **Drag-and-drop on Files section:** The "No files yet, drag some here" empty state has a `dragover`/`drop` event handler that accepts file drops and uploads them to FUB's file storage, associating them with the contact's `person_id`.

11. **Avatar color assignment:** Contact avatars (LM in teal) appear to be auto-assigned from a palette based on the contact's initials or ID. Matt Ryan's agent avatar uses orange/amber. These are consistent across all views.

12. **"via automation" attribution:** When an email is sent through a FUB action plan or campaign, the activity event stores a `via` field = "automation" which renders as the "via automation" label in the timeline. Emails sent manually by an agent do not show this label.
